description: This file defines a composable hook 'useTimesheetAPIs' for interacting with timesheet-related API endpoints in a Vue.js application. It includes data interfaces for timesheet entities, functions for fetching and updating timesheets and their entries, and manages reactive state.

methods.name: fetchTimesheet
methods.description: Fetches a timesheet for a given date and optional employee number.

methods.name: updateTimesheet
methods.description: Updates a specific timesheet with an action and optional comment.

methods.name: fetchTimesheetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves entries for a specific timesheet, optionally for an employee timesheet.

methods.name: updateTimesheetEntries
methods.description: Updates entries of a timesheet, optionally for an employee timesheet.
